metadata.question: Was there an active fire present in Monte Pisano in Northern Italy between February 24, 2019 and February 26, 2019?

data.raw_code: The question is about detecting active fires in Monte Pisano, Northern Italy during a specific 3-day period (Feb 24-26, 2019). For fire detection, I should use: - MODIS Active Fire data (MODIS/006/MCD14DL) or VIIRS Active Fire data (NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP14IMGML) - These collections provide fire detection confidence and fire radiative power Location: Monte Pisano in Northern Italy - I'll create a point geometry around that area Time: Feb 24-26, 2019 Strategy: 1. Use VIIRS data (higher resolution than MODIS) for better detection 2. Check if any fire pixels are detected in the area during the period 3. Count fire pixels and check confidence levels 4. If collection is empty, try MODIS as fallback 5. If no fires detected, answer B (No), if fires detected, answer A (Yes) For validation: - Check collection size first - Count fire pixels - Consider high confidence fires only (>30% confidence) ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions geometry = ee.Geometry.Point([10.5, 43.8]) # Monte Pisano area, Northern Italy start_date = '2019-02-24' end_date = '2019-02-26' # 2. Data Acquisition - VIIRS Active Fire data viirs_fire = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP14IMGML') \ .filterBounds(geometry) \ .filterDate(start_date, end_date) # Check collection size viirs_count = viirs_fire.size().getInfo() print(f"VIIRS Fire Images: {viirs_count}") if viirs_count == 0: # Try MODIS as fallback modis_fire = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MCD14DL') \ .filterBounds(geometry) \ .filterDate(start_date, end_date) modis_count = modis_fire.size().getInfo() print(f"MODIS Fire Images: {modis_count}") if modis_count == 0: print("C1") exit() else: fire_collection = modis_fire else: fire_collection = viirs_fire # 3. Count fire pixels with confidence > 30% fire_mask = fire_collection.map(lambda img: img.select('Confidence').gt(30)) total_fire_pixels = fire_mask.sum().reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=geometry.buffer(5000), # 5km buffer around point scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9 ).getInfo() fire_count = sum(total_fire_pixels.values()) print(f"High confidence fire pixels: {fire_count}") # 4. Final determination if fire_count == 0: print("B") else: print("A") ```

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
geometry = ee.Geometry.Point([10.5, 43.8])  # Monte Pisano area, Northern Italy
start_date = '2019-02-24'
end_date = '2019-02-26'

# 2. Data Acquisition - VIIRS Active Fire data
viirs_fire = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP14IMGML') \
    .filterBounds(geometry) \
    .filterDate(start_date, end_date)

# Check collection size
viirs_count = viirs_fire.size().getInfo()
print(f"VIIRS Fire Images: {viirs_count}")

if viirs_count == 0:
    # Try MODIS as fallback
    modis_fire = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MCD14DL') \
        .filterBounds(geometry) \
        .filterDate(start_date, end_date)
    
    modis_count = modis_fire.size().getInfo()
    print(f"MODIS Fire Images: {modis_count}")
    
    if modis_count == 0:
        print("<answer>C1</answer>")
        exit()
    else:
        fire_collection = modis_fire
else:
    fire_collection = viirs_fire

# 3. Count fire pixels with confidence > 30%
fire_mask = fire_collection.map(lambda img: img.select('Confidence').gt(30))
total_fire_pixels = fire_mask.sum().reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
    geometry=geometry.buffer(5000),  # 5km buffer around point
    scale=1000,
    maxPixels=1e9
).getInfo()

fire_count = sum(total_fire_pixels.values())
print(f"High confidence fire pixels: {fire_count}")

# 4. Final determination
if fire_count == 0:
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
